rows.post: Engineering Officer/ Shift Engineer/ Junior Engineer/ Diploma Engineer
rows.essential_requirement: Experience evaluating and troubleshooting plant machinery; overall engineering management and coordination of project operations, including planning, budgeting, scheduling and detailed engineering activities; ability to lead teams while ensuring safety, integrity, financial and contractual requirements are met

Knowledge of dairy industry processes such as processing, standardisation, packaging and dispatch of milk and milk products; experience in powder plants or ice cream plants in dairy/food processing preferred

Knowledge of animal husbandry, artificial insemination, productivity enhancement programmes, Strategy Calf Rearing Programme (CRP), dairy cooperative society activities, extension services and implementation of dairy project activities

Knowledge of Windows, macOS and Linux operating systems; software deployment and hardware troubleshooting; IT support, network and system maintenance; data entry; ERP user support; IT asset management; data protection compliance

Clerical and administrative work including maintaining records and files, data entry, preparing letters and reports, handling correspondence and day-to-day office activities; proficiency in MS Office; ability to communicate in English, Hindi and Gujarati

Supervising milk procurement and collection at village dairy cooperative societies; conducting DSC audits, quality audits and record verification; monitoring milk quality and procurement records; preparing reports and maintaining field records

Operation, monitoring, maintenance and basic troubleshooting of industrial machinery and utility systems relevant to the trade; knowledge of safety procedures, routine checks and preventive maintenance; experience in dairy, food & beverage, pharmaceutical or process industries preferred
Knowledge of milk volume measurement, milk sampling, quality testing and accurate record-keeping; ability to travel and supervise milk collection activities while maintaining accurate records
